agent_note: First-person simultaneous present narration (37 quotes, all classified). 18 event / 10 gnomic / 9 dialogue / 0 unclear; 15 present, 3 past = 83.3% present. Quotation marks survive only sporadically in this book's Goodreads scrape (present in q08980, q08988, absent elsewhere), so dialogue was assigned via vocatives, direct address, speech markers and register -- signal recorded per quote. Gnomic yield is high (27%) because the aphorism bias is strong here: several are proverbs carrying a past-tense attribution tag ('Mama always said', 'As Mama used to say'), which I treated as tags, not story events, since the generalizing content is present tense. The 3 past event quotes are a recollection/backstory strand (q08960 character backstory summary, q08981 immediate retrospection, q08994 recollected description), not a second narrating position. Lands in the 80-85% present band flagged in METHODOLOGY for audit. Flip-risk: q08975, spoken-register past recounting with no marks -- if it is narration rather than speech it becomes event/past and drops the split to 15/4 = 78.9%.
